testName: Text re-enter field validation for profile creation
description: Verify that text re-enter field should throw validation errors if the values in actual field and confirm field are not equal when creating a profile

expectedResults.passwordMismatchError: Please ensure that both password fields match.

notes.precondition: Include re-enter for validation should be enabled on password field
notes.testScenario: Create profile (Platform) : Text re-enter field should throw validation errors if the values in actual field and confirm field are not equal
wizardSteps: Step 1: Basic Information - Fill First Name, Last Name, Email (required fields)
Step 2: Documents - Upload resume via file chooser
Step 3: Login Information - Enter Password and Re-enter Password fields with validation
validationBehavior: When passwords do not match: Display error 'Please ensure that both password fields match.'
When passwords match: Profile creation succeeds and user is redirected to profile view
additionalNotes: Test validates re-enter field functionality for any text field with validation enabled
Password field is used as example, but pattern applies to any field with re-enter validation
Manual test steps mention checking other tabs (Leave of Absence, Goals, Competencies) but this is optional verification
